rules: The roster is the owner's to change (CLAUDE.md "Choosing models", the owner, 2026-10-11), through switch-model.mjs and the /switch-model skill: implementer.default is a Claude Code alias or a model id the session's provider serves, on which the implementer subagent is spawned inside Claude Code (Opus spawns Sonnet; under Z.AI `sonnet` is GLM-5.3 Flash), or `session`: the main session implements directly where the provider cannot spawn one; either runs through the session's Anthropic environment, so its family is the session's (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, or HARNESS_SESSION_FAMILY). reviewer.default is the OpenCode model that reviews unless the user names another (review.mjs --reviewer). The main session asks the user before each implementation and each review, proposing these defaults. blocked lists families or id fragments that never run. Never the session's family as reviewer; no chains, no chooser, no quota check.

choices: <any model id the session's provider serves>

mimo-flash.note: MiMo v2.6 Flash on OpenCode Go, no variant (it offers none); its own family (mimo). Login: XDG_DATA_HOME=<scripts data dir> opencode console login.

luna.note: GPT-5.6 Luna on the direct OpenAI route, the default reviewer: fast, proves findings by mutation; fine for a narrow final check (T12).

luna-6.note: GPT-6 Luna: registered only; it shares OpenAI's pool with Sol.

sol.note: GPT-6 Sol, the hard reviewer before 6.1; kept for an explicit --reviewer.

sol-6.1.note: GPT-6.1 Sol at effort low: the adversarial reviewer for hard research (every finding proven live on T08, T10, T12, T29); it holds to proof-level completeness, so the brief says "practical, not theoretical".

sol-6.1-medium.note: The same model at effort medium, for a last-round re-check when the owner asks (T38).

mimo-pro.note: MiMo v2.6 Pro on OpenCode Go, heavy, no variant; its own family (mimo).

glm.note: GLM-5.3 on the Z.AI coding plan at low (it offers no medium): thorough on evidence as a reviewer (T06, T07). 3x in weekday peak from 8 Oct 2026.

glm-flash.note: GLM-5.3 Flash on the Z.AI coding plan: a light reviewer for small PRs; it once approved with a proven bypass rated non-blocking (L47), so the brief says what blocking means.

ali-glm.note: GLM-5.3 on the Alibaba Token Plan at low: the same model as glm on another route. key: the env var ALIBABA_TOKEN_PLAN_API_KEY, never opencode auth login it.

ali-qwen-max.note: Qwen 3.8 Max on the Alibaba Token Plan at low; heavy; a family nothing else here shares. key as ali-glm.

ali-qwen-flash.note: Qwen 3.8 Flash on the Alibaba Token Plan at medium (no plain high); light. key as ali-glm.

mm-m3.note: MiniMax-M3, variant thinking (it offers only none and thinking), heavy; a family of its own. Key: the env var MINIMAX_API_KEY (pass it to the unit with -E); never opencode auth login it.

mm-m2.7.note: MiniMax-M2.7, light, no variant (it offers none). Key as mm-m3.
